other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
Applicant must be studying in a government school in Madhya Pradesh.
Applicant must be studying in class 1 to 12 or pursuing college education.
School must be within a maximum distance of 3 km for girls or 8 km for boys.
Preference is given to applicants residing in remote rural areas.
benefits_summary: Provides free residential facilities including accommodation, electricity, water, meals, furniture, bedding, library, coaching, and basic amenities.
